name: Theo

ideals: A man is only as good as his word
flaws: Struggles to forgive himself for past mistakes
personality.bond: He once saved the life of a young princess and now feels personally responsible for the royal family's safety.
personality.motivation: To prove he’s more than just a provincial guard and become a true knight of Cornelia

background.origin_story: Theo was born to a blacksmith and a healer in Cornelia. After his older brother died during a monster raid, Theo swore to become strong enough to protect others.
notable_events: Fought off a wyvern during a caravan raid
Promoted to Captain of the Night Watch after thwarting a smuggling ring
background.current_goal: Earn recognition from the Crown to be knighted

fears: Failing those he’s sworn to protect
Being forgotten if he dies in obscurity
religion_or_beliefs: Worships the Light—believes in order, virtue, and sacrifice

rivals: Ser Dorian, a pompous knight who mocks Theo's commoner roots
relationships.romantic_interest: Cassia, a traveling dancer who visits Cornelia every spring

inventory: Steel buckler with Cornelia's crest, forged by his father
secrets: He let a fugitive go once—an exiled mage who claimed the royal court was hiding something dark
quotes: If I die with my boots on, let it be standing in the way of harm.
Steel breaks, flesh bleeds—but duty doesn't bend.
theme_music: Epic orchestral march with somber undertones (think Nobuo Uematsu meets Bear McCreary)
